# Anu v0.1.0 - Table of Contents

Composable Elixir SDK for the WhatsApp Business API

## Pages

- [anu](https://anu.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [Contributing to Anu](https://anu.hexdocs.pm/contributing.md)
- [LICENSE](https://anu.hexdocs.pm/license.md)

## Modules

- [Anu](https://anu.hexdocs.pm/Anu.md): Composable Elixir SDK for the WhatsApp Business API.
- [Anu.Adapter](https://anu.hexdocs.pm/Anu.Adapter.md): Behaviour for message delivery adapters.
- [Anu.Adapters.Local](https://anu.hexdocs.pm/Anu.Adapters.Local.md): Development adapter that logs messages to the console.
- [Anu.Adapters.Meta](https://anu.hexdocs.pm/Anu.Adapters.Meta.md): Production adapter that sends messages via the Meta WhatsApp Cloud API.
- [Anu.Adapters.Test](https://anu.hexdocs.pm/Anu.Adapters.Test.md): Test adapter that sends messages to the current process mailbox.
- [Anu.Config](https://anu.hexdocs.pm/Anu.Config.md): Runtime configuration resolution for Anu.
- [Anu.Error](https://anu.hexdocs.pm/Anu.Error.md): Represents an error returned by the WhatsApp Cloud API or an internal failure.
- [Anu.Event.Message](https://anu.hexdocs.pm/Anu.Event.Message.md): Represents an inbound WhatsApp message received via webhook.
- [Anu.Event.Status](https://anu.hexdocs.pm/Anu.Event.Status.md): Represents a message status update received via webhook.
- [Anu.Message](https://anu.hexdocs.pm/Anu.Message.md): A composable message builder for the WhatsApp Business API.
- [Anu.Response](https://anu.hexdocs.pm/Anu.Response.md): Represents a successful response from the WhatsApp Cloud API.
- [Anu.Row](https://anu.hexdocs.pm/Anu.Row.md): Represents a row item inside a list message section.
- [Anu.Section](https://anu.hexdocs.pm/Anu.Section.md): Represents a section in a list message.
- [Anu.Template](https://anu.hexdocs.pm/Anu.Template.md): Helpers for building template message components.
- [Anu.TestAssertions](https://anu.hexdocs.pm/Anu.TestAssertions.md): ExUnit assertion helpers for testing Anu message delivery.
- [Anu.Webhook.Handler](https://anu.hexdocs.pm/Anu.Webhook.Handler.md): Behaviour for handling incoming WhatsApp webhook events.
- [Anu.Webhook.Parser](https://anu.hexdocs.pm/Anu.Webhook.Parser.md): Parses Meta webhook JSON payloads into event structs.
- [Anu.Webhook.Plug](https://anu.hexdocs.pm/Anu.Webhook.Plug.md): A Plug that handles incoming WhatsApp webhook requests.
- [Anu.Webhook.Signature](https://anu.hexdocs.pm/Anu.Webhook.Signature.md): HMAC-SHA256 signature verification for Meta webhook payloads.
